HUGE NEWS FOR CLIPPY: :nkotada: 

On Clippy 1.101,the new lint `undocumented_may_panic_call` adds `// PANIC` comments, and `#[clippy::may_panic]` attributes will be introduced.

This allows you to have a FULLY UNPANICKABLE RUST CODEBASE.

Useful for embedded development, useful for critical software, useful for kernels (Rust For Linux will be using it).

#rust #programming #opensource
